intent: 荒野上的龙卷风：漏斗状的烟尘柱旋转，带 3D 透视感
pass_criteria: vertical funnel/column of particles, wider top narrower base (or readable taper)
dense enough to read as a coherent volume, not a coil/spring
3D perspective feel (camera looking at the funnel, not flat 2D)

expressions: var angRev=12.0;var hPer=2.0;var c=(time/hPer)%2;var p=1-Math.abs(1-c);var ang=time*angRev*2*Math.PI;var yB=700,yT=70;var y=yB+(yT-yB)*p;var rB=8,rT=150;var r=rB+(rT-rB)*Math.pow(p,0.8);[640+r*Math.sin(ang),y,r*Math.cos(ang)]

prior_iterations.critique: The recipe's structure carries: t2 reads as a genuine funnel (wide top, tapering base, 3D coil ellipses under the camera rig) and t5 shows sweep/rotation evolution with a nicely dissipating dust crown. Miss: the coil-spring residue — at t5 the lower funnel reads as discrete stacked loops rather than a fused dust wall (the recipe's documented residual; turbulence 40 merges only partially).

Overshot: turbulence 95 shredded the funnel — t2 is a chaotic scribble tangle with no readable silhouette, t5 keeps a coil core but drowns it in scattered wisps. Worse than iter1 (compositional params are non-monotonic — the recipe's tuned 40 was closer than 95). Split the difference.
